data.title: Creek Waters
data.about:
Creek Waters by Emaar is your key to the world of luxurious high-rise island life. This groundbreaking project is setting a new standard for urban renewal in Dubai Creek by fusing cutting-edge design with creative landscaping. Be lost in a natural haven, where you may forget about the stresses of everyday life.

Apartments with one to four bedrooms, townhouses with three bedrooms, and five bedroom penthouses are available for your enjoyment. Creek Waters exemplifies the best of both worlds, with some of the most breathtaking views in all of the Dubai Creek area. Emaar is proud to give you a private place to call your own while while praising the collective benefits of the outdoors. Think of how nice it would be to unwind in your own home while taking in the beautiful sights of Dubai Creek.

Creek Island, where Creek Waters may be found, is an integral part of the Dubai Creek Harbour development. Because of Dubai’s well-connected public transit system, getting about the city is a breeze. Get the best of both worlds in this haven of opulence and practicality.

location_tile.title: Utmost Convenience & Connectivity
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Creek Waters’ convenient location on Creek Island within Dubai Creek Harbour and the city’s seamless public transit system make it a breeze to go about the city. Our community is conveniently located among excellent educational institutions, a wide variety of retail establishments, and a lively nightlife.

  • 10 Mins from Dubai International Airport
  • 10 Mins walk from Creek Promenade.
  • 15 Mins from Burj Khalifa
  • 40 Mins from Al Maktoum International Airport
